prompts.name: manage_application_window
prompts.description: Guided workflow for controlling the ControlDesk application window: check visibility, show/hide, resize, reposition, and set fullscreen. Use before running automated workflows to ensure ControlDesk is visible and correctly positioned on screen. Accepts optional position and state parameters.

prompts.name: configure_bus_logging
prompts.description: Step-by-step guide for setting up ControlDesk bus logging: create a logger, configure it, activate, start capturing, and stop. Covers logger lifecycle including clear-all and remove operations. Accepts optional logger name and database path for context.

prompts.name: run_bus_monitor
prompts.description: Guided workflow for creating a ControlDesk bus monitor, starting live capture, and saving the captured data to a file. Covers monitor lifecycle including clear-all and remove operations. Accepts optional monitor name and output file path.

prompts.name: replay_bus_data
prompts.description: Guided workflow for replaying previously recorded bus data in ControlDesk: create a replay session, configure the source file, and play back. Covers replay lifecycle including clear-all and remove operations. Accepts optional replay name and source file path.

prompts.name: manage_bus_filters
prompts.description: Guided workflow for creating and managing ControlDesk bus message filters: create a filter, configure which frames to include/exclude, start filtering, and clean up. Filters are used in combination with bus loggers to selectively capture frames.

prompts.name: run_calibration_workflow
prompts.description: Step-by-step guide for running a ControlDesk online calibration session: start calibration, switch pages, refresh parameters, and stop. Accepts an optional platform name to scope the workflow.

prompts.name: proposed_calibration_flow
prompts.description: Guided workflow for the ControlDesk Proposed Calibration feature: start the proposal session, let the model suggest changes, then apply or cancel. Use when coordinating AI-suggested parameter updates with human review.

prompts.name: manage_calibration_data_sets
prompts.description: Guided workflow for switching between working and reference data-set pages in ControlDesk calibration. Data sets hold ECU parameter values; the working page is editable while the reference page holds the last committed baseline.

prompts.name: ecu_diagnostics_setup_workflow
prompts.description: End-to-end guide for setting up a ControlDesk ECU Diagnostics session: create Diagnostic2 platform, load ODX database, select vehicle, configure logical link with protocol and interface, then connect. Accepts optional platform_name and odx_directory_path to pre-fill steps.

prompts.name: ecu_diagnostics_link_configuration
prompts.description: Focused guide for configuring the logical link protocol and interface on an existing Diagnostic2 platform. Use when the platform and ODX database are already loaded and a vehicle has been selected, and only the link protocol or interface needs to be changed.

prompts.name: manage_instrument_workflow
prompts.description: Guided workflow for managing instruments on a ControlDesk layout: enumerate instruments and types, add, configure, move, arrange, and connect/disconnect signals. Accepts optional layout and instrument name parameters.

prompts.name: manage_layout_workflow
prompts.description: Guided workflow for managing ControlDesk layouts: enumerate layouts, create, open, configure, save, close, activate, and perform I/O operations (export/import layouts and connection files). Accepts an optional layout name to target a specific layout.

prompts.name: run_measurement_workflow
prompts.description: End-to-end workflow for configuring and running a ControlDesk measurement recording: raster setup, signal configuration, buffer tuning, start, stop, and export. Accepts optional raster name, sample time, signal list, and recording name.

prompts.name: add_measurement_bookmark
prompts.description: Guided workflow for annotating a running measurement recording with a bookmark. Bookmarks mark key events (e.g., test start, fault injection) in the recording so they can be identified during post-processing. Accepts an optional bookmark label.

prompts.name: manage_data_loggers
prompts.description: Guided workflow for creating and managing ControlDesk data loggers: create a named logger, configure its output file, start/stop logging, list all loggers, and remove when done. Data loggers capture signals to external files independently of the main measurement recording.

prompts.name: configure_measurement_triggers
prompts.description: Guided workflow for configuring ControlDesk measurement triggers: create trigger rules with time-limit or signal-based conditions to automatically start or stop recordings. Accepts optional signal path for trigger-based conditions.

prompts.name: manage_project_workflow
prompts.description: Step-by-step guide for creating or opening a ControlDesk project, adding a platform, and setting up an experiment. Accepts optional project path to distinguish new vs. existing projects.

prompts.name: export_experiment
prompts.description: Guided workflow for exporting a ControlDesk experiment to a zip archive: select the experiment, export it, and verify the output file. Accepts optional experiment name and output path.

prompts.name: manage_project_roots
prompts.description: Guided workflow for managing ControlDesk project root folders: register new root folders, set the active root, list all roots, and remove roots that are no longer needed. Project roots are file-system folders that ControlDesk searches for projects.

prompts.name: manage_experiments
prompts.description: Guided workflow for the full experiment lifecycle in a ControlDesk project: create, rename, clone (save-as), import, and remove experiments. Use this when the project is already open and you need to manage its experiments.

prompts.name: run_recorder_main_workflow
prompts.description: End-to-end workflow for using the ControlDesk main recorder: configure the recorder, add signals to record, start, pause/resume, and stop recording. The main recorder is the primary data-capture component for signal recording in ControlDesk. Accepts optional signal path and output file.

prompts.name: start_automation_session
prompts.description: Step-by-step guide for setting up a full ControlDesk automation session: verify server, start the application, open a project, connect a platform, and confirm the environment is ready. Use at the beginning of any automation workflow.

prompts.name: diagnose_connection
prompts.description: Diagnostic guide for troubleshooting ControlDesk COM / connection failures. Use when tools return BridgeError, RPC errors, or unexpected disconnections. Accepts an optional error message and the failing tool name for context.

prompts.name: manage_tool_windows
prompts.description: Guided workflow for managing ControlDesk tool windows: list available windows, show or hide a specific window, configure its docking position, and close when done. Useful for arranging the ControlDesk UI before running automated tests. Accepts an optional window name to target a specific tool window.

prompts.name: read_write_variables
prompts.description: Guided workflow for reading and writing ControlDesk variables: find, inspect, read, optionally write, and verify. Covers scalars, arrays, curves, maps, and strings. Useful for testing calibration values, signal manipulation, and variable access.

prompts.name: discover_variables
prompts.description: Guided workflow for discovering and inspecting ControlDesk variables: search by pattern, list all variables, browse group contents, and inspect array elements. Use this to explore what variables are available before reading or writing.

prompts.name: manage_variable_descriptions
prompts.description: Guided workflow for managing ControlDesk variable description files (A2L/DCM): list loaded descriptions, activate a specific file, and remove unused ones. Variable descriptions must be loaded before variables become accessible.
